title: Huevos rancheros with black beans
steps: Finely chop the onion, garlic and chilli and soften them in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cumin, simmer for 5 minutes and season with salt.
Rinse the beans and warm them in the sauce.
Make hollows with a spoon, crack in the eggs and cook covered for 5–6 minutes until set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, spoon the beans and eggs on top and sprinkle with coriander.
